summary: Oragenics Inc. filed an 8-K on May 7, 2026, disclosing a signed Letter of Intent with Sigyn Therapeutics to license CardioDialysis, an extracorporeal blood purification technology, for treating TBI-induced systemic inflammation. The license would grant exclusive rights to develop and commercialize CardioDialysis for TBI and other neurodegenerative diseases. No deal price, premium, or specific financial terms were announced. The license is complementary to Oragenics' existing ONP-002 program. The transaction is contingent on a definitive agreement. Watch for execution risk and potential shareholder updates on licensing milestones.
